# Quantum Chemistry

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. The connector generates a readable
experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## Geometry Optimization

Optimize a molecule's geometry with the selected DFT functional, basis set, charge, spin multiplicity, and dispersion correction. The supplied submission contract accepts one molecule file path or SMILES value at the user interface and sends that same validated value in both `molecule_path` and `smiles`.

Exact job name: `Geometry_Optimization`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `molecule_path` | string | yes | file_or_value | One molecule file path (`.xyz`, `.cif`, `.sdf`, `.gjf`, or `.mol`) or SMILES string. The supplied wire contract copies this exact value to both `molecule_path` and `smiles` inside `experimentData`. Upload a local file first and use its returned platform path. |
| `method` | string | yes | value | DFT functional. |
| `basis` | string | yes | value | Basis set. |
| `charge` | integer | yes | value | Net molecular charge. Use `0` for a neutral molecule and an explicit signed integer for an ion. |
| `spin_multiplicity` | integer | yes | value | The supplied Geometry Optimization payload uses a number: 1 for singlet, 2 for doublet, or 3 for triplet. |
| `dispersion` | string | yes | value | Dispersion correction. |
| `use_gpu` | boolean | no / mode-dependent | value | Enable GPU acceleration. Supplied example: `true`. Confirm before submission. |
| `use_xtb_preopt` | boolean | no / mode-dependent | value | Run xTB pre-optimization. Supplied example: `true`. Confirm before submission. |
| `use_alchemi_prescreen` | boolean | no / mode-dependent | value | Enable Alchemi conformer prescreening. Supplied example: `false`. Confirm before submission. |
| `n_conformers` | integer | no / mode-dependent | value | Positive number of conformers. Supplied example: `5`; no upper bound was supplied. |
| `compute_resp` | boolean | no / mode-dependent | value | Compute RESP charges. Supplied example: `false`. Confirm before submission. |
| `smiles` | string | yes | value | Same value as molecule_path in the supplied request, including its platform reference when using a file. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## HOMO-LUMO & Reactivity Descriptors

Calculate global HOMO-LUMO/reactivity descriptors and optionally atom-local Fukui descriptors for one molecule.

Exact job name: `Reactivity_Descriptors_Combined`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TASK_NAME` | string | yes | value | Exact task selector. Preserve uppercase field spelling. |
| `molecule_path` | string | yes | file_or_value | One uploaded `.xyz`, `.cif`, `.sdf`, or `.gjf` platform path, or one validated SMILES string. Do not create a separate `smiles` field. |
| `method` | string | yes | value | DFT functional. |
| `basis` | string | yes | value | Basis set. |
| `charge` | number | yes | value | Net molecular charge. Ask the user; the recording value is not a default. |
| `spin_multiplicity` | number | yes | value | 1 for singlet, 2 for doublet, or 3 for triplet. Confirm consistency with charge and electron count. |
| `calculate_local` | boolean | yes | value | Whether to calculate local Fukui descriptors. |
| `dispersion` | string | yes | value | Dispersion correction. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## Single Point Energy

Calculate a molecule's electronic energy and electronic properties at a fixed geometry without optimizing or moving its atoms. The platform uses GPU-accelerated GPU4PySCF for rapid single-point DFT calculations. Use this tool for energy ranking, conformer comparison, electronic-property profiling, reaction-intermediate screening, charge/dipole analysis, method benchmarking, or validation of an already optimized structure.

Exact job name: `Single_Point_Energy`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `task_name` | string | yes | value | User-confirmed task label inside experimentData; distinct from experiment_name. |
| `molecule_path` | string | yes | file | Platform path to the fixed input geometry. Proven input is an uploaded XYZ path. UI-supported file extensions: `.xyz`, `.gjf`, `.cif`, and `.sdf`. Upload a local file first and pass the returned platform path. |
| `method` | string | yes | value | DFT functional. Proven value: `"B3LYP"`. UI options: `B3LYP`, `PBE`, `PBE0`, `M06-2X`, `wB97X-D`, `wB97M-V`, `HF`, `LDA`, `TPSS`, and `CAM-B3LYP`. |
| `basis` | string | yes | value | Basis set. Proven value: `"def2-TZVP"`. Documented options: `def2-SVP`, `def2-TZVP`, `def2-TZVPP`, `def2-QZVP`, `cc-pVDZ`, `cc-pVTZ`, `cc-pVQZ`, `STO-3G`, `6-31G`, `6-31G*`, `6-311G**`, `aug-cc-pVDZ`, and `aug-cc-pVTZ`. |
| `charge` | integer | yes | value | Total formal charge of the whole modeled species. Proven value: `0`. Use `0` for neutral species and explicit positive/negative integers for ions. |
| `spin_multiplicity` | string | yes | value | **The verified API payload uses a string.** Proven value: `"1"`. Use `"1"` for singlet, `"2"` for doublet, or `"3"` for triplet; set radicals and metal systems explicitly. |
| `dispersion` | string | yes | value | Proven value: `"D3BJ"`. Exact UI options: `D3`, `D3BJ`, `D4`, or `None`. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.
